objective: Remove 8-second profile identity save timeout caused by unnecessary Classroom roster full-profile similarity scans; preserve matching and security.
productionBaselineEvidence: Live Supabase BUKLOD Connect Postgres SQLSTATE 57014 at 2026-11-12 00:51:35, 00:51:51, 00:53:57 UTC; three PATCH /rest/v1/profiles HTTP 500 at ~8070ms; 25 unresolved roster entries and 562 active profiles. Canonical main 6f6f732e9aa3c095b5b327dde23cb7e9166826ae; DEV-only PR until required checks pass.
chosenApproach: Add v_score >= 0.97 guard before competitor-wide scan and reset v_second for each pending Classroom roster intent; preserve exact username, token, strict fuzzy and manual review semantics.
selectionRationale: Competitor score is only used for strict-fuzzy v_score >= 0.97 auto-qualification, so scanning when score is lower cannot affect decisions. This precisely removes avoidable N*M work without changing decisions.
acceptanceChecks: Engineering Accountability low-cost test and manifest gate passes
SQL after migration validates trigger and security
Identity save no longer times out at 8 seconds under representative workload
Exact username, token, manual review and matching thresholds unchanged
No changes to Android media playback and AdMob
preserveBehaviors: No changes to current Android player, Wall/Marites, AdMob, PTT or RC OTA
Classroom identity matching and enrollment safeguards retained
Profile RLS and official system admin safeguards retained
No direct production database data writes during DEV QA
alternativeApproaches: Increase authenticated statement_timeout beyond 8 seconds: rejected because it hides an unbounded synchronous scan and makes users wait
Remove Classroom roster trigger: rejected because this would silently break enrollment reconciliation
Guard the expensive competitor scan using its pre-existing qualification threshold: selected
releaseStatus: DEV/PR only pending CI and verified production backend promotion; no Android OTA.
